character_vibe_description: Character & Vibe An honest snapshot - the energy, the people, the pace. The kind of thing no other directory tells you. Versova has a relaxed, bohemian seaside soul. Mornings begin with fishing boats heading out and joggers on the cleaned-up beach, afternoons are quiet in the leafy Seven Bungalows and Aram Nagar lanes, and evenings come alive with Yari Road cafés, sunset crowds and a creative, easy-going energy. It's coastal Mumbai at its most laid-back. Home to the traditional Koli fishing community, a large film-and-music fraternity along Yari Road, artists in Aram Nagar and well-settled families in Seven Bungalows, Versova blends old fishing-village heritage with new-age creative living - a mix unlike anywhere else in the city.

faq.question: What is Versova known for?
faq.answer: Versova is known for Versova Beach (famous for the world's largest beach cleanup), the historic Versova Koliwada fishing village, its ferry jetty connecting to Madh Island, Yari Road's film fraternity, seafood eateries and being the western terminus of Mumbai Metro Line 1.

faq.question: What is the pin code of Versova?
faq.answer: Versova primarily uses pin code 400061, with parts of the Yari Road and Seven Bungalows belt also covered under 400061 and 400053.

faq.question: What are the sub-areas within Versova?
faq.answer: The main micro-localities within Versova are Versova Beach, Versova Koliwada (fishing village), Yari Road, Seven Bungalows, Aram Nagar and Versova Village near the jetty.

faq.question: What is the property price in Versova?
faq.answer: Property prices in Versova range from around ₹1.4–2 Cr for a 1BHK in Seven Bungalows/Yari Road to ₹2.5–4 Cr for a 2BHK, with premium sea-facing flats commanding much higher rates. Rental rates range from ₹35,000 to ₹1 lakh+ per month depending on the sub-area and flat size (as of May 2026).

faq.question: How to commute from Versova?
faq.answer: Versova is the western terminus of Mumbai Metro Line 1 (Versova–Ghatkopar), giving fast metro access across the city. It is also served by BEST buses, the Versova–Madh ferry jetty, and road links via JP Road, Yari Road and Link Road to Andheri and the airport (about 20 minutes away).

faq.question: Which hospitals are in Versova?
faq.answer: Major hospitals in and near Versova include Kokilaben Dhirubhai Ambani Hospital (Four Bungalows), SRV Hospital, and several multi-speciality clinics and nursing homes across the Seven Bungalows and Yari Road belt.

faq.question: Which schools are in Versova?
faq.answer: Notable schools in and near Versova include Tridha School (Yari Road), Cardinal Gracias High School (Four Bungalows), Ryan International School (Lokhandwala) and several playschools across the Seven Bungalows belt.
